title: vektor /// no. 052 — Two mathematicians, one phone call, two days.
description: On Sunday 6 September 2026 Tristan Buckmaster took two calls with OpenAI about the problem he and Levent Alpöge had been working on. Two days later both sides published. Every primary document is on this page — all three preprints, Buckmaster's four-page signed statement, OpenAI's 166-page paper and its own announcement, Tao's two posts, and what the Clay Mathematics Institute has actually said, which is far less than the headlines.
